g.title: BPC
g.text: Branch-and-Price-and-Cut for the VRPP (Barnhart, Hane & Vance 2000 framework)

Set-partitioning master over route columns λ_k · RCSPP pricing with ng-route relaxation · lifted-cover / RCC / SRI cuts · hierarchical branching · DFS with LP-basis warm start. Objective: maximise profit = Σ_k (R·waste_k − C·dist_k)·λ_k

g.title: cluster_cg
g.text: 3. Column generation + cutting planes at a node

g.title: cluster_rcspp
g.text: — RCSPPSolver.solve(): elementary/ng shortest path with resource (load) constraint

g.title: a_sub
g.text: BaseRoutingPolicy: load capacity, R, C · BPCConfig → params
sub-problem: vrpp=True → all bins, mandatory = selected list

g.title: a_run
g.text: run_bpc(sub_dist, sub_wastes, capacity, R, C, params,

g.title: a_map
g.text: profit = Σ_routes (R·waste − C·km) · map to global tour

g.title: s_params
g.text: search depth_first · branching divergence · cuts saturated_arc_lci · ng size 8 · rcspp_timeout 30 s

g.title: s_master
g.text: max Σ profit_k·λ_k s.t. Σ_k a_ik·λ_k = 1 (mandatory) / ≤ 1 (optional),
strict set partitioning if branching = ryan_foster

g.title: s_init
g.text: Initial columns: greedy (or profit-aware greedy) insertion

g.title: s_pricer
g.text: RCSPPSolver(n, dist, wastes, capacity, R, C,
ng-route relaxation, ng size, timeout, max_labels)

g.title: s_build
g.text: Phase 1 (feasibility) if mandatory nodes exist, else Phase 2 (profit)

g.title: s_tree
g.text: strategy = divergence | ryan_foster | edge | …) · root node

g.title: b_loop
g.text: while tree not empty and nodes_explored < max_bb_nodes:

g.title: b_apply
g.text: apply_branching_to_master: reset λ upper bounds to 1,
set λ_k = 0 for columns violating any constraint;
pass forbidden / required arcs to pricing

g.title: b_lr
g.text: (forced-in ∪ mandatory, forced-out) with ≤ 5 % of remaining time

g.title: b_ng
g.text: node budget = remaining time (root: ≤ 40 % of time_limit)

g.title: b_arcfix
g.text: forbid arcs whose min reduced cost > parent LP − incumbent

g.title: g_elem
g.text: Enforce strict elementarity in pricing for nodes in
Ryan-Foster pairs, forced node-visits and active SRI subsets

g.title: b_store
g.text: node.lp_bound = lp_obj · node.route_values = λ · node.lp_basis = basis

g.title: b_edgefix
g.text: Reduced-cost edge fixing with global UB / incumbent LB

g.title: b_order
g.text: divergence + DFS → right child (shorter path kept) popped first
else child with higher LP hint first; tie → fewer local constraints first

g.title: e_best
g.text: routes = columns with λ_k > 0.5 at best node

g.title: g_ret
g.text: return obj_val, λ, final basis, timed_out

g.title: g_basis
g.text: first pass: restore parent LP basis (warm start)
later passes: sift global column pool → re-activate positive-RC columns,

g.title: g_lp
g.text: Solve RMP LP (Gurobi, remaining time budget)

g.title: g_farkas
g.text: price with Farkas dual ray → add columns restoring feasibility

g.title: p_rc
g.text: node reduced prize: r_i = R·w_i − π_i (Phase II) or Farkas ray (Phase I)
pre-process constraints → forbidden arcs, required succ/pred,

g.title: g_duals
g.text: Duals from master: node π_i, RCC, SRI (Jepsen 2008),
LCI γ_lm + node α (Gu et al. 1995), clique, multistar

g.title: g_conv
g.text: pricing converged for this cut round

g.title: g_price
g.text: add routes with reduced cost > rc_tolerance

g.title: g_to_q
g.text: pricer timed out 3× in a row ?

g.title: g_lag
g.text: Lagrangian bound z_UB = RMP + fleet · max(0, max_rc)

g.title: g_sep
g.text: orthogonality ≤ 0.8): saturated-arc LCI, RCC, SRI, LM-rank-1,
min-cut, triangle clique, node-profit bound, path elimination

g.title: p_dp
g.text: max-heap on reduced cost, start at depot (rc 0, load 0)

g.title: p_ret
g.text: return top max_routes routes by reduced cost

g.title: p_ext
g.text: extend label u → v for v in k nearest neighbours (all if exact_mode):
skip fixed / forbidden arcs, visited, ng-memory, RF separation,
wrong required predecessor · load + w_v ≤ capacity
rc += r_v − C·d_uv − Σ cut duals (RCC, SRI state, LCI α, clique)

g.title: p_dom
g.text: dominance: drop label if an existing label at v dominates
(rc, load, ng-set, SRI state); remove labels it dominates

g.title: p_depot
g.text: completion-bound pruning → candidate Route(nodes, profit, rc)

g.title: r_y
g.text: most fractional y_v = Σ_k a_vk·λ_k (optional node),

g.title: r_div
g.text: Divergence branching (BHV2000 §4.3): trace two highest-λ routes
from depot, first divergence node d → arc_set_1 (shorter path arc)
vs arc_set_2 (other outgoing arcs); child forbids one set

g.title: r_rf
g.text: Ryan-Foster: node pair (i,j) with 0 < Σ_k a_ik a_jk λ_k < 1
→ together | separate (master hardened to strict SP)

g.title: r_edge
g.text: Edge branching: most fractional arc flow x_uv → x_uv = 0 | 1
